datasetName: StudySense AI - Genuine Module-Aware Exam Performance Dataset
description: Standardized schema for collecting authentic student preparation metrics mapped to verified university examination outcomes.
groundTruthPolicy: Zero synthetic or fabricated labels. Records are only admitted into training datasets when verified actual exam marks are recorded.

subject_id.description: KTU Subject identifier (e.g. cs-cn, cs-se, cs-math, cs-ml)

exam_id.description: Unique identifier of the examination instance

selected_module_ids.description: List of 1 to 4 syllabus module IDs tested in this exam

total_selected_topics.description: Total syllabus topics within the selected module scope

completed_selected_topics.description: Number of topics learned/mastered strictly in selected modules

topic_completion_pct.description: Percentage of topics completed in the selected modules

total_quiz_attempts.description: Total quiz attempts completed for topics in selected modules

total_quiz_questions.description: Total quiz questions answered in selected module topics

total_quiz_correct.description: Total quiz questions answered correctly in selected module topics

quiz_accuracy_pct.description: Authentic quiz accuracy percentage across selected modules

has_quiz_data.description: True if student attempted quizzes in the selected modules

active_study_minutes.description: Total logged active study minutes for topics in selected modules

study_consistency_score.description: Normalized consistency score based on dedicated study time

previous_exam_score.description: Student's previous actual exam performance in this subject, if available

actual_exam_score.description: TARGET VARIABLE: Verified actual exam mark on a 0-100 scale recorded post-exam

ground_truth_ready.description: True if actual_exam_score is recorded and verified

recorded_at.description: Timestamp when the pre-exam feature snapshot was recorded
